correction_factor_status_note: DEMOTED to diagnostic-only by the truth-fitted correction-factor gate: these per-slug factors were derived from the SAME cells' NCU truth, so they must not multiply a deployable prediction. The cache_predictor apply helpers no-op on the deployable value for this family and record the would-be corrected value under diagnostics with this status token. A future slug-disjoint re-derivation (calibration-split slugs disjoint from every scored cell) may flip the status to slug_disjoint_calibrated in code+fixture lockstep.
purpose: Calibration provenance for the L1 subfamily correction factors in workloads/simbench_bw/cache_predictor.py: _L1_SILU_ELEMENTWISE_CORRECTION_FACTOR (single value over silu correctness + timing) and _L1_SHARED_REDUCTION_CORRECTION_FACTORS (per-slug dispatch over layernorm/rmsnorm/softmax_safe).

source_data.walker_baseline_derivation: post-R30b walker output with corrected `_PC_RE` classifier + warmup_launches=5 + carveout-aware capacity. Reduction cells uncorrected walker output collapses to 1.0 because the working set fits in cache after the warmup launches; per-slug factor equals NCU truth to give exact match.

shared_reduction.chosen_factor_provenance: R17 per-slug dispatch (mirrors R6's L2 reduction allowlist pattern). With the post-R30b walker (corrected _PC_RE + warmup_launches=5 + carveout-aware capacity), the L1 walker's uncorrected output for the shared_reduction subfamily is 1.0 across all three slugs (working set fits in cache after warmup). A single factor over the subfamily cannot simultaneously satisfy the per-cell L1 budget for all three slugs because their NCU truths diverge significantly (layernorm 0.290, rmsnorm 0.364, softmax_safe 0.484). Per-slug dispatch assigns each slug its own factor equal to its NCU truth (rounded to 2 decimal places). The control / headline `chosen_factor` is set to layernorm's factor (the tightest named-cell budget). All three named cells reach rel_err < 0.02 against NCU truth, a strict improvement over pre-R48.

silu_elementwise.chosen_factor_provenance: ceil_to_2dp(geomean(silu_correctness, silu_timing)) per R46/R47 rounding policy. Walker uncorrected output = 1.0 for both silu shape points after warmup; geomean(NCU_correctness=0.230, NCU_timing=0.202) = 0.21558; ceil_to_2dp = 0.22.
